record.name: Nura Dev - Voice for AI Coding
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence: Nura Dev turns your iPhone into a voice remote for terminal-based AI coding agents. Pair your CLI in seconds, hold the mic button to speak your prompt, and read the agent's reply on your phone. Stay in the loop wherever you are — kitchen, car, walk, bed — without losing your place in a long-running coding session. WHAT YOU CAN DO • Hold-to-talk voice control — speak naturally, no wake word • Replies in real time — every agent response streamed to your phone as text • Real-time activity feed — see tool calls, file edits, and commands as the agent works • Approve tool calls from your phone — keep dangerous actions safe even when you're away from the keyboard • Persistent chat history — pick up where you left off when you reopen the app • Multi-session support — one app, all your paired coding agent sessions HOW IT WORKS 1. Run your coding agent CLI in your terminal with the Nura plugin installed 2. Scan the pairing QR code from the app 3. Hold the mic, talk, release 4. Read the agent's reply, or tap a tool-call card to approve or deny REQUIRES • A compatible terminal-based AI coding agent and any required subscription • iOS 18 or later • A Google or Apple account for sign-in • A working network connection to your paired terminal session PRIVACY Voice audio is transcribed through Nura's relay and not stored. Your code and conversations stay between your terminal and your iPhone. See nuradev.app/privacy.html for full details. SUBSCRIPTION Nura Dev requires a $4.99/month subscription after a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. record.name: Vibe Pocket: AI Coding Agents
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AI coding agents that run in the cloud. No computer needed.

Most mobile coding apps connect your phone to your own computer, so that computer has to stay on. Vibe Pocket works differently. You get your own cloud workspace, and your AI agent works there. Start a task from your phone, close the app, and the agent finishes the job. Come back later to read the reply, check the changes and run the result.

CHOOSE YOUR AGENT
Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Muse Code by Meta, Grok Build, Gemini and Antigravity, and more. Add more than one agent to the same workspace and switch between them.

CHAT WITH IT
Describe a feature, a fix or a question in plain words. Pick the model and how hard it should think, then send. Replies, file changes and errors show up right in the chat.

SIGN IN FROM CHAT
Use the AI plan you already have, or an API key. Sign in to your agent account inside the chat with a device code or a pasted code. No terminal steps.

SEE AND RUN YOUR CODE
- Editor: open and edit files with syntax highlighting.
- Run: start your app in the workspace and open it, or share a preview link.
- Projects: keep several projects in one workspace, see Git changes and commit.
- Terminal: there whenever you want full control.

START IN SECONDS
Start from an empty project, one of your GitHub repositories or any public repository. Your files stay in your workspace between sessions.

PLANS
Vibe Pocket is a monthly subscription. You bring your own AI plan or API key; we do not sell model credits, and AI usage is billed by your provider.
- Lite: 1 workspace. Sleeps after 20 minutes idle.
- Plus: 3 workspaces. Sleeps after 2 hours idle.
- Pro: 5 workspaces. Always on, never sleeps.
On every plan, a task that is already running finishes even if you close the app. A sleeping workspace wakes up when you open it again.

GOOD FOR
Quick fixes on the go, trying an idea from the couch, keeping a side project moving, or checking on a long task from your phone.

Code from your phone. No computer needed.

record.description_evidence:
Zero-setup Python IDE that runs your code offline, an AI coding assistant, and a developer toolbox — in a first-class citizen app for iPad and iPhone.

Juno is designed to cover all your Python coding needs, supporting both Python scripts (.py) and Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) — a document format focused on applying Python to data analysis and computational science.

FREE FEATURES

- Navigate and manage files and folders, quickly preview documents and media
- Browse and edit Jupyter notebooks in a powerful, customizable notebook editor with beautifully rendered previews — editing is free
- Write and edit code sources, scripts, JSON, XML, and other text-based formats — one versatile editor for code and text alike, with syntax highlighting
- Add quick access bookmarks for file system locations outside the app's sandbox, or simply open documents in place

PRO FEATURES

Only one thing in Juno is Pro: running code. Even that is free to try — a generous trial allowance lets you run notebooks, scripts, projects, and the REPL before you buy. After the trial, running code unlocks with a one-time Pro purchase — not a subscription.

- Run Jupyter notebooks, Python scripts, and whole projects locally with the built-in Python 3.13 interpreter and a full suite of up-to-date, preinstalled scientific and data packages — entirely offline
- Explore interactively in a Python REPL — open a standalone prompt, or drop into it after running a script or project to keep exploring what it defined
- Search the variables, functions, and imports in your session with the Object Inspector — no need to print each one
- Open any folder as a project: file tree, multiple editor tabs, run any script, with a coding assistant aware of the whole project
- Keep side outputs — Preview, Browser, Console, Object Inspector — open as side-by-side tabs in an output sidebar
- View local web servers and HTML your code produces in a built-in browser with developer debug tools
- Long-running scripts and Jupyter sessions keep going in the background
- Automate with Shortcuts and Siri: App Intents run a Python file, run Python code, or open a file — pass arguments and files, capture output, and chain actions
- Leverage powerful data analysis, machine learning and developer tools: NumPy, pandas, Polars, DuckDB, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, pygame, and more
- Enjoy painless package management: install any pure Python package with an intuitive package manager

AI CODING ASSISTANT

The assistant runs on your account or your key, not ours: sign in with your account or add your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, and requests go straight from your device to your provider. You control what you spend and share — Juno never takes a cut.

GAMES AND EMULATORS

pygame is built in: write games with touch controls, sound, and full-screen graphics, and play them on your device. Eight complete games ship as examples, alongside NES, Game Boy, and CHIP-8 emulators written in Python, each with a library of freely licensed homebrew games — play them, then open the code to see how they work.

PYTHON MEETS iOS

Reach native iOS APIs straight from Python with the built-in juno modules: clipboard, Keychain, device info, location, motion sensors, contacts, reminders, photos, sound, notifications, sharing, and Bluetooth. Show native alerts and pickers, present full-screen image, video, and web previews, or call into UIKit, Foundation, and any Objective-C framework via the Objective-C bridge.

SCRIPTS AND NOTEBOOKS

Python scripts (.py) get snappy, intelligent code completion, a console with a full terminal emulator, and a built-in media viewer for code-generated images, plots, and web apps. Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) keep live code, markdown text, plots, images, and LaTeX equations in one file, with every output embedded right in the document — a perfect playground for data analysis and computational science.

Python 3 is a general-purpose language, which means it can be used to build just about anything, which will be made easy with the right tools/libraries.

Start in Creative Lab

This is vibe coding for learning
Vibe coding is not only for apps and websites. In VibeBlocks, you practice vibe coding across creative coding, game coding, block coding, Arduino, Micro:bit, and Physical AI projects. The goal is not just to generate code. The goal is to understand what changed, why it works, and how to direct AI better next time.

Build from screen to hardware
Begin with projects on the screen, then move toward real sensors, motors, circuits, and robots. VibeBlocks connects creative coding, STEM learning, and physical computing in one mobile flow, with no PC required.

What you can build and practice:
- Interactive art and creative coding projects
- Games and MakeCode Arcade-style game logic
- Block coding for beginners, plus the bridge from blocks to real code
- Arduino coding with a built-in circuit simulator
- Micro:bit coding on mobile
- Sensor, motor, LED, buzzer, and display projects
- Physical AI and robotics challenges with motion and behavior
- Reading, testing, debugging, and improving AI-generated code

How it works:
1. Create: tell AI what you want to make
2. Inspect: read the code, blocks, or behavior AI created
3. Test: run the project on screen or in the simulator
4. Redirect: change the prompt, logic, or settings
5. Build again: improve the result and learn from the process

- Teaches you to direct AI, not just consume its output
- 39 structured courses with 365+ lessons, plus missions and a free creative space for your own ideas

A. No PC and no kit needed — even the Arduino circuit simulator runs right on your phone (an internet connection is required). Real hardware is optional, for when you want to take projects further.
Q. Do I need coding experience?
A. No. Start with block coding and guided courses; AI explains everything you build along the way.
Q. Can schools and clubs use it?
A. Yes. VibeBlocks supports classroom, coding club, and workshop use, with structured courses and missions.

record.name: KKCode - OpenCode Mobile
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
KKCode is the mobile client for OpenCode — the AI coding agent that runs on your Mac.

Connect to your local OpenCode server over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, and bring AI-powered coding assistance wherever you go.

FEATURES

• Multiple AI Models — Switch freely between DeepSeek, Zhipu, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, and any model supported by your OpenCode server. Model preferences are remembered per session and persist across conversations.

• Streaming Responses — Responses stream in real time. Scroll freely while the AI is generating; KKCode keeps your position and never interrupts your reading experience.

• Code & Markdown Rendering — Enjoy full syntax highlighting for code blocks, inline formatting, and rich markdown display.

• Tool Call Transparency — See exactly which tools the AI invoked, review file changes, and inspect inputs and outputs for every tool call.

• Image Attachment — Send screenshots or design mockups directly from your photo library.

• Session Management — Organize conversations by project directory. Rename, swipe to delete, or bulk remove sessions whenever you need.

• Split View Support — Keep your session list and active chat side by side for a desktop-class multitasking experience.

• Offline-Safe Draft — Your unfinished messages are automatically saved per session and restored when you return.

• Multi-language Support — English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Português, Русский.

• Dark & Light Mode — Automatically follows your system appearance.

HOW IT WORKS

KKCode connects to the OpenCode server running on your Mac.

Start the server with:

opencode serve –hostname 0.0.0.0 –port 4096

Then add your server connection in KKCode and start chatting.

For remote access outside your home network, Tailscale is recommended.

KKCode requires an OpenCode server to function. It does not include built-in AI inference or AI models.
